entities.description: A person is sitting cross-legged on a gray fabric couch, wearing a lavender satin pajama set with white piping and buttons. The couch has a modern design with clean lines and a light gray upholstery, and there is a beige throw pillow placed behind the person.

clothing.top: lavender satin pajama shirt with white piping and buttons
clothing.bottoms: lavender satin pajama pants with white piping

entities.description: A young woman with medium skin tone and voluminous curly brown hair sits cross-legged on a grey sofa, wearing a lavender satin pajama set with white piping and round wire-rimmed glasses. She has a neutral expression and is looking directly at the camera with her hands resting on her legs.

clothing.details: white piping on collar, cuffs, and pocket

entities.description: A square, beige throw pillow with a textured, woven fabric surface rests against the arm of a gray sofa. The pillow is positioned next to a smooth, shiny purple fabric, likely a duvet or sheet, which drapes in the foreground.

A window covered by white horizontal blinds with a soft, diffused light filtering through, creating a bright and neutral background. The blinds are closed, with the slats aligned horizontally, and the window frame is not visible in the crop.
